fallbackEntries.title: Crossing the Pyrenees in Reverse — Arrival at Saint-Jean-Pied-de-Port
fallbackEntries.excerpt: After tracing the Camino Portugués Central from Coimbra, looping through Muxía and Finisterra, and walking the entire Camino Francés eastward, the Iberian chapter closes at the foot of the Pyrenees.

walkedLegs.name: Leg I • Camino Portugués (Central)
walkedLegs.span: Coimbra → Porto → Tui → Santiago de Compostela
walkedLegs.summary: Northbound through the eucalyptus ridges of Beira Litoral, across the Douro in Porto, over the Labruja pass past Ponte de Lima, crossing the Minho at Valença/Tui into Galicia.

walkedLegs.name: Leg II • Muxía & Cape Finisterra Loop
walkedLegs.span: Santiago → Muxía → Cape Finisterra → Cee → Santiago
walkedLegs.summary: West from Santiago via Negreira and Olveiroa, splitting north at Hospital to the Atlantic rocks of Muxía, south via Lires to the Zero Kilometer lighthouse at Finisterra, then returning through Cee to Santiago.

walkedLegs.name: Leg III • Camino Francés in Reverse
walkedLegs.span: Santiago → O Cebreiro → León → Burgos → Pamplona → Saint-Jean-Pied-de-Port
walkedLegs.summary: Turning east against the stream of westbound pilgrims: climbing O Cebreiro and Cruz de Ferro, crossing the Meseta through León and Burgos, winding across La Rioja and Navarra, and descending from Roncesvalles over Col de Lepoeder into France.

milestones.title: Coimbra, Portugal
milestones.summary: First steps north along the central Portuguese route toward Porto and Galicia.

milestones.title: Porto, Portugal
milestones.summary: Crossed the Douro and followed the ancient interior way through Rates, Barcelos, and Ponte de Lima.

milestones.title: Valença / Tui (Border)
milestones.summary: Crossed the international bridge over the Minho River from Portugal into Galicia, continuing via Pontevedra and Padrón.

milestones.title: Santiago de Compostela
milestones.summary: Reached via the Camino Portugués (KM 365), departed west to Muxía and Finisterra, and returned (KM 576) to begin walking the Camino Francés in reverse.

milestones.title: Muxía (Virxe da Barca)
milestones.summary: Followed the northern split past Olveiroa and Hospital to the windswept granite headland of the Costa da Morte.

milestones.title: Cape Finisterra (Km 0.000)
milestones.summary: Walked south via Lires to the Atlantic promontory at the End of the Earth, then looped back through Cee toward Santiago.

milestones.title: O Cebreiro
milestones.summary: Ascended eastward out of Galicia past Sarria and Triacastela into the mountain passes of León.

milestones.title: León, Spain
milestones.summary: Descended from Cruz de Ferro and Astorga across Hospital de Órbigo onto the broad plains of the Meseta.

milestones.title: Burgos, Spain
milestones.summary: Crossed the endless steppe through Sahagún, Carrión de los Condes, Frómista, and Castrojeriz.

milestones.title: Logroño, Spain
milestones.summary: Walked east through Santo Domingo de la Calzada and Nájera across the vineyards of La Rioja.

milestones.title: Pamplona, Spain
milestones.summary: Passed Estella, Puente la Reina, and Alto del Perdón before climbing through Zubiri toward Roncesvalles.

milestones.title: Saint-Jean-Pied-de-Port, France
milestones.summary: Current position. Crossed the Pyrenees in reverse from Roncesvalles over Col de Lepoeder into France, completing the Iberian chapter.
